consts.name: dcuCustomChartLow
consts.comment: the book-wide custom encounter chart doctrine (p. 7): the d8+d12 roll generates the 2-20 die range - the low end.

consts.name: dcuCustomChartHigh
consts.comment: the 2-20 range high end: a 2 or a 20 is the unique-powers slot on every custom chart in the book.

consts.name: dcuEtherealTimeFactor
consts.comment: the Ethereal subjective-time factor: for every 10 turns that pass, the effects are as if a single turn passed - aging at the subjective rate (a ghost ages 1d4 years, not 10-40; a potion of longevity restores 10%).

consts.name: dcuEtherealVisionYards
consts.comment: clear vision extends about 100 yards in the thick soup of the plane; encounter distances run 80-120 yards; infravision fails (same temperature as the surroundings), ultravision works normally.

consts.name: dcuFadeRounds
consts.comment: becoming ethereal takes a round to fade away; leaving rematerializes in one round; the phase spider pattern - reappear and bite in one round, the next round to return to the ethereal state.

consts.name: dcuDeepEncounterChance
consts.comment: Deep Ethereal encounters: a 1-in-10 chance every four hours, or whenever someone steps through a curtain; the Border Ethereal follows the bordering plane's matrices.

consts.name: dcuMagicPlusReduction
consts.comment: magical weapons are reduced by one plus (a long sword +2, +3 vs reptiles becomes +1, +2 vs reptiles); armor and protection devices likewise lose one plus - except weapons keyed to ethereal or ethereal-affecting creatures, which remain unimpaired.

consts.name: dcuThiefShadowBonus
consts.comment: the Ethereal works very well for the thief: add +20% to hide in shadows and move silently; climb sheer surfaces has little effect.

consts.name: dcuDemiPlaneNamedCount
consts.comment: the four named demi-planes: Shadow (the silver curtain), Time (translucent, the 1d10-years-younger risk), Electro-Magnetism (the copper curtain, dying into Lightning), and Imprisonment (the legend, curtain color unrecorded).

bools.name: dcuNoFallingEth
bools.comment: the Ethereal has an up and a down, but falling is impossible: the traveler and the medium are the same substance and it supports all objects.

bools.name: dcuNormalWeaponsZeroBase
bools.comment: normal weapons inflict 0 base damage on ethereal targets - Strength, Dexterity and specialization bonuses still apply; magical weapons (retaining at least +1) inflict full damage; normal armor is ignored (AC 10) with Dexterity still applying.

bools.name: dcuBorderCrossingBlind
bools.comment: the Border Ethereal traveler is invisible to the bordering plane (revealed as a smoky shade by detect etherealness or detect invisible), cannot attack across the border nor be attacked across it - phase door and dispel magic can pull beings out.

bools.name: dcuHealingSubjectiveSlow
bools.comment: natural healing occurs at the subjective rate - 10 times slower than on the Prime; a raised character rests 10 days for every day dead; golem and clone times run in subjective time.
